INSERT INTO TB_SCHEDULE ( SCHEDULE_NO, MEMBER_NO, SCHEDULE_NAME, HEADCOUNT, DESCRIPTION, TRAVEL_START, TRAVEL_END, SCHEDULE_STATUS, CREATED_DATE ) VALUES ( #{scheduleNo}, #{memberNo}, #{scheduleName}, #{headCount}, #{description}, #{travelStart}, #{travelEnd}, 'N', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SCHEDULE WHERE SCHEDULE_STATUS = 'N'

SELECT s.SCHEDULE_NO, s.MEMBER_NO, s.SCHEDULE_NAME, s.DESCRIPTION, s.HEADCOUNT, s.TRAVEL_START, s.TRAVEL_END, s.CREATED_DATE, m.MEMBER_NAME, a.MEMBER_ID FROM TB_SCHEDULE s JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON s.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO JOIN TB_AUTHENTICATION a ON m.MEMBER_NO = a.MEMBER_NO WHERE s.SCHEDULE_STATUS = 'N' ORDER BY s.CREATED_DATE DESC

SELECT s.SCHEDULE_NO, s.MEMBER_NO, s.SCHEDULE_NAME, s.DESCRIPTION, s.HEADCOUNT, s.TRAVEL_START, s.TRAVEL_END, s.SCHEDULE_STATUS, s.CREATED_DATE, m.MEMBER_NAME, a.MEMBER_ID FROM TB_SCHEDULE s JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON s.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO JOIN TB_AUTHENTICATION a ON s.MEMBER_NO = a.MEMBER_NO WHERE s.SCHEDULE_NO = #{scheduleNo} AND s.SCHEDULE_STATUS = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SCHEDULE SET SCHEDULE_NAME = #{scheduleName}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, HEADCOUNT = #{headCount}, TRAVEL_START = #{travelStart}, TRAVEL_END = #{travelEnd} WHERE SCHEDULE_NO = #{scheduleNo}
UPDATE TB_SCHEDULE SET SCHEDULE_STATUS = 'Y' WHERE SCHEDULE_NO = #{scheduleNo}
